question: The circumference of the two circles is 264 m and 308 m respectively. What is the difference between the area of the larger circle and the smaller circle?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in **Area** = (C₂² − C₁²) / 4π

Area Difference = (C₂ + C₁) × (C₂ − C₁) × 7 / 88

Area Difference = (308 + 264) × (308 − 264) × 7 / 88

Area Difference = 572 × 44 × 7 / 88 = 572 × 7 / 2 = 286 × 7 = 2002 m².

**∴ The correct answer is 2002 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Circumference of small circle (C₁) = 264 m

Circumference of large circle (C₂) = 308 m

**Formula Used:**

Circumference = 2 × π × r

Area = π × r²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/964f43f7a9085997a4ee6c89ad9188ef503cdcfb795b8edfe67cedb65ffe34f9.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r₁ = 264

⇒ r₁ = (264 × 7) / 44 = 6 × 7 = 42 m

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r₂ = 308

⇒ r₂ = (308 × 7) / 44 = 7 × 7 = 49 m

⇒ Difference in Area = π × (r₂² − r₁²)

⇒ Difference = (22/7) × (49² − 42²)

⇒ Difference = (22/7) × (49 + 42) × (49 − 42)

⇒ Difference = (22/7) × 91 × 7

⇒ Difference = 22 × 91 = 2002 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 2002 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Circle

The space occupied by a circle in a 2D plane is given by the formula Area = πr² or Area = πd²/4.

Circumference to Radius

The distance around the circle is Circumference = 2πr. Thus, the radius can always be found as r = C / 2π.

Area of a Ring (Annulus)

The area between two concentric circles with radii R and r is Area = π(R² − r²) = π(R + r)(R − r).</p
